summary: Lithium Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K disclosing results of its annual general meeting held June 19, 2026. The meeting saw 24.51% of shares voted; all eight director nominees were re-elected with strong support (88.91%-99.07%). Shareholders also approved financial statements, an amended equity incentive plan, auditor appointments, executive compensation resolutions, and a voting rights representative. No special situation or transformative event was announced. The filing is a routine periodic report of voting results under Swiss corporate law, mapping to a standard U.S. proxy result disclosure. No action or risk-arb angle exists.
